items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I'd heard him play, actually, at the Vanguard when he first arrived with Paul Motian and Scott LaFaro.

ctx.x: Uh … you know, the piano player, you know before I met Bill, I heard a lot of stories about his habit and his propensities, you know. When I met him – we did a recording on Riverside Records. I'd heard him play, actually, at the Vanguard when he first arrived with Paul Motian and Scott LaFaro. I heard him on a couple of Miles' records but, you know, the piano was not my focus at the time. I just wanted to know harmony. What's going on with the drum sound, you know? So, while I knew him, I didn't really know him.…
